title: PubMedCausal: A Span-Level Annotated Corpus for Causal Relation Extraction in Biomedical Text
abstract: arXiv:2605.28363v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causal relation extraction (CRE) is central to biomedical text mining, but current resources often conflate causal relations with broader associations, restrict annotation to sentence-level examples, or focus mainly on explicit causal cues. This limits their usefulness for evaluating whether models can recover causal claims as they are actually expressed in biomedical text. We introduce PubMedCausal, a span-level annotated corpus for biomedical CRE built from PubMed abstracts. The corpus contains 30,000 paragraph-level rows, including 3,945 causal rows and 6,491 adjudicated cause--effect pairs. Each causal relation is annotated with full-text cause and effect spans, causality type, and sententiality, enabling evaluation of both causal detection and full-span causal extraction. translated_title: PubMedCausal：用于生物医学文本中因果关系抽取的跨度级标注语料库
translated_abstract: 因果关系抽取是生物医学文本挖掘的核心任务，但现有资源往往将因果关系与更广泛的关联关系混为一谈、将标注局限于句子级示例，或主要聚焦于显式因果线索。这限制了它们在评估模型能否还原生物医学文本中真实表达的因果论断方面的作用。我们提出了PubMedCausal，一个基于PubMed摘要构建的生物医学因果关系抽取跨度级标注语料库。该语料库包含30,000个段落级条目，其中含3,945个因果条目和6,491个经裁定确认的因果-结果对。每个因果关系均标注了完整的因果跨度、因果类型及句级性，从而支持对因果检测和全跨度因果抽取两项任务的评估。我们在检测和抽取两种设定下对判别式编码器和开源生成式模型进行了基准测试。在因果检测任务上，生物医学编码器……
tldr: 本文构建了基于PubMed摘要的跨度级因果标注语料库PubMedCausal，通过完整的因果-结果跨度、因果类型与句级性标注，实现了对因果检测与全跨度因果抽取更贴近真实文本表达的评估。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PubMedCausal, a span-level annotated corpus built from PubMed abstracts with 30,000 paragraph-level rows and 6,491 adjudicated cause-effect pairs, enabling realistic evaluation of both causal detection and full-span causal extraction in biomedical text.
